delivery.en: Parcels: the gate askari, the door, or a post office
delivery.zh: 包裹交給門衛 askari，或放門口、到郵局領取

readback.en: 07 mobiles go in short groups; amounts in shillings; confirm if Swahili-hour time is used
readback.zh: 07 手機分短組唸；金額用先令。若用斯瓦希里語鐘點要確認。

fraud.en: A request to share an M-Pesa PIN, or a fake parcel fee message, is a scam
fraud.zh: 要你分享 M-Pesa PIN，或假包裹簡訊要補費的都是詐騙

habits.en: Swahili first; English only if they switch. Use M-Pesa. Not Telebirr or MVola.
habits.zh: 以斯瓦希里語為主，對方改英語再跟。用 M-Pesa，不用 Telebirr、MVola。

stall_local.en: Get stuck on a USSD menu timing out, a mobile-money app spinning, or a power cut.
stall_local.zh: 卡在 USSD 選單逾時、行動錢包一直轉、或停電。

reason.en: French door-staff term from the mixed parent
reason.zh: 所屬地區混用的法語門房詞

talk_style_diff.en: More Swahili-forward than the Kenya-coloured parent; less English slang. Keep titles in business and short, clear replies.
talk_style_diff.zh: 比偏肯亞的所屬地區更常先用斯瓦希里語，少用英語俚語。公事用稱謂，回覆短而清楚。

uncertain: 接聽用 Habari 或 Hello 都有；此次以斯瓦希里語 Habari 為主，實際比例未找到官方統計。
Tigo／Mixx 等其他錢包也很常見，但此次主要來源是 Vodacom M-Pesa，故未寫進主詞彙。
假包裹簡訊的當地個案，公開來源不如肯亞完整。
